verses.1: On the day of Pentecost, during the time when one week had passed from the resurrection, Mary Magdalene and another Mary came to see the tomb.
verses.2: And behold, a great earthquake took place! For an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and when he came near, he threw down the stone, and it was set aside above it.
verses.3: His appearance was like a star, and his clothing was white as snow.
verses.4: But because of his fear, those who were terrified became like dead people.
verses.5: Then the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid. I know that you are seeking Jesus, who was crucified.”
verses.6: “That’s not true,” he said. “Now, see where he was.”
verses.7: And quickly, he said to his disciples, “He has risen from the dead. Now, let us go to Galilee, and there you will see Him.” They said, “We will go.”
verses.8: And we left the tomb quickly, with fear and great joy in our hearts. We told his disciples about it.
verses.9: And when Jesus saw them, he said to them, “Rejoice!” But those who came forward stepped forward and bowed down to him.
verses.10: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid. Tell my brothers to go into Galilee. There they will see me.”
verses.11: As they were being led along, some people from the monastery came to the city and reported to the priests everything that had happened.
verses.12: And after being gathered together with the elders, they received coins as payment, and these coins were given to the soldiers.
verses.13: Saying, “You said that his disciples came at night and stole him while we were asleep.”
verses.14: And if this is heard by the ruler, then we will persuade him, and we will also make you all united in our efforts.
verses.15: And those who received the silver did as they were instructed. This practice has been practiced among the Jews until today.
verses.16: But the twelve disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had gathered them.
verses.17: And when they saw him, they bowed down in respect; but those who were afraid did not do so.
verses.18: And when Jesus came near, he spoke to them, saying: “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.”
verses.19: Therefore, you taught all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
verses.20: I will teach them to always follow all that I have commanded you. And see, I will be with you every day, until the end of the summer.
